name: Northeastern University
meets_full_need_notes: Northeastern meets 100% of demonstrated financial need for all admitted domestic undergraduates. The university has significantly expanded its financial aid budget in recent years.
no_loan_notes: Northeastern does not have a no-loan policy. Federal loans are included in most aid packages, though the university has reduced loan burdens for lower-income students.

merit_thresholds.notes: Northeastern offers a range of merit scholarships: Dean's Scholarships, Global Scholars Awards, and the Torch Scholars Program for first-generation students. Most are competitive and require strong academic credentials.

ed_aid_implications: Northeastern offers both Early Decision (binding) and Early Action (non-binding). Financial aid packages are identical regardless of application plan.
special_programs: Global Scholars Awards (merit for international students)
appeal_policy: Northeastern students may appeal their financial aid package through the Office of Student Financial Services by submitting a Special Circumstances Appeal with documentation.
